basic_info.description: North Slope Potrero Hill with stunning views of downtown SF and the Bay Bridge! This  2-bed, 2-bath home features an incredible location and a desirable floorplan. Enjoy the wood-burning fireplace and large picture windows in the stylish living room, which gives way to the dedicated dining area and peaceful private patio. These living and entertaining spaces seamlessly connect w/ the open kitchen, which offers stainless steel appliances, beautiful quartz countertops and white shaker cabinets that span up to the ceiling, providing ample storage space. The home benefits from an abundance of natural light, captivating views, and stunning sunsets. A generous primary en-suite bedroom features a sizable closet and a spa-like bathroom. Includes parking, in-unit laundry and additional storage. Located in the highly desirable Victoria Mews, residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including a pool, spa, sauna, gym, tennis courts, clubroom, and beautifully landscaped gardens with tranquil streams. Walkscore 94! Close proximity to neighborhood favorites like Whole Foods, local restaurants, UCSF and shops, plus easy access to 101, 280, and Caltrain. Stroll to 18th St. amenities including great restaurants and gourmet coffee! See it today!
